questions.question: At which ground did N Njani record their career-best bowling figures (7-24, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Khaya Majola Oval, against Tuskers on 2017/02/25.

questions.question: "Tuskers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: KwaZulu-Natal Inland was rebranded Tuskers (KwaZulu-Natal Coastal became the Dolphins).

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)' in the 24/25 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Faye Tunnicliffe holds it, with a total of 63.

questions.question: Tazmin Brits set a database record (22/23 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 89. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Fours', held by Tazmin Brits.

questions.question: At Bloemfontein Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Badgers?
